acceptance_criteria.description: Every accepted source byte is pinned by digest and size and validation fails closed on drift.
Run, observation, and status counts reconcile exactly per benchmark.
Each task row retains source run, unit, attempt, method/model/code, split, metric, denominator, outcome, and known digests.
No host path, IP address, credential value, authenticated URL, raw answer, trace, log, or gold byte is committed.
Import, ledger, paper table, focused tests, and repository validation pass.

objective: Create a sanitized content-addressed typed-results-only projection of the validated H20 catalog for BiomniBench-DA, CMTBench, NatureBench, and SWE-bench Verified.
title: Import the H20 experimental-results catalog into the unified ledger
